description: Window operations across all visible apps: list all windows with their bounds and state, focus a window, move or resize a window, minimize/restore, enter or exit fullscreen, or close. Every action, list included, scripts System Events and requires Accessibility. Every action except list targets one window: the one titled window_title, or app_name's frontmost window (window_title takes precedence when both are given). Focus raises the window and brings its app forward, as fullscreen does before it changes a window; no action launches an app.

app_name.description: Running app whose frontmost window to target, matched without regard to case against its application name ("Visual Studio Code"), localized name ("Code"), or process name ("firefox"). Ignored when window_title is given.

fullscreen.description: For fullscreen: true=enter fullscreen, false=exit fullscreen. Omit to toggle the window's current state.

height.description: Window height in pixels for resize/move_resize. Must be greater than 0.

minimized.description: For minimize: true=minimize to the Dock (the default), false=restore.

width.description: Window width in pixels for resize/move_resize. Must be greater than 0.

window_title.description: Window title, matched exactly but without regard to case, in any app. Takes precedence over app_name when both are provided.

x.description: Left edge x-coordinate for move/move_resize. Screen coordinates.

y.description: Top edge y-coordinate for move/move_resize. Screen coordinates.

name: macos_manage_windows

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `accessibility_required`: Any action, list included, is denied Accessibility or Automation permission. `not_running`: app_name, given without window_title, names no running app. `window_not_found`: No window has the given window_title, or the app_name app has no window. `minimize_unsupported`: action=minimize targets a window whose AXMinimized attribute cannot be read or set, or that does not reach the requested state within 4 s of the write. `fullscreen_unsupported`: action=fullscreen targets a window whose AXFullScreen attribute cannot be read or set, or that does not reach the requested state within 4 s of the write. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

success.description: True when the operation completed; for minimize and fullscreen, the window read back in the requested state. Present for write actions.

window.description: The targeted window, read back after the operation. Present for write actions except close.

app.description: Process name of the app the window belongs to, as System Events reports it (e.g. "firefox" for Firefox).

display_index.description: The display the window overlaps most: the index macos_manage_displays action=list reports for each display (0 = the main display, the one with the menu bar). Null when the display frames could not be read or the window overlaps no display.

fullscreen.description: True when the window is in fullscreen, read from its AXFullScreen attribute. Null when the attribute could not be read.

minimized.description: True when the window is minimized to the Dock, read from its AXMinimized attribute. Null when the attribute could not be read.

x.description: Window left edge position in screen coordinates.

y.description: Window top edge position in screen coordinates.

windows.description: All visible windows across all apps. Present for action=list.

items.description: Window with its bounds and state.

app.description: Process name of the app the window belongs to, as System Events reports it (e.g. "firefox" for Firefox).

display_index.description: The display the window overlaps most: the index macos_manage_displays action=list reports for each display (0 = the main display, the one with the menu bar). Null when the display frames could not be read or the window overlaps no display.

fullscreen.description: True when the window is in fullscreen, read from its AXFullScreen attribute. Null when the attribute could not be read.

minimized.description: True when the window is minimized to the Dock, read from its AXMinimized attribute. Null when the attribute could not be read.

x.description: Window left edge position in screen coordinates.

y.description: Window top edge position in screen coordinates.
